spans.s:
n. (-तं)
Sprinkling, pouring or dropping forth, falling as an unctuous substance, oozing, trickling, &c.
E.
च्युत to wet or moisten, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्नी-त्नं)
1 A mover, a goer, one who moves or goes.
2

Abandoned, wicked, void of virtue or purity.
E.
च्यु to go, Uṇādi affix त्नण्.
